dishes.name: Romazava
dishes.description: Romazava is the national dish of Madagascar, consisting of greens, zebu meat, tomatoes, and onions, typically accompanied by a portion of rice.

dishes.name: Ravitoto
dishes.description: Ravitoto is a traditional dish in Malagasy cuisine. Ravitoto means 'crushed cassava leaves'. These are specifically sweet cassava leaves pounded with a mortar or meat grinder.

dishes.name: Mofo gasy
dishes.description: Mofo Gasy, translated as "Malagasy bread", is a Malagasy traditional recipe typically eaten as a breakfast. It consists mainly of rice flour and sugar fried within a specific mold. Mofo gasy can also be made with coconut milk.

dishes.name: Koba
dishes.description: Koba is a sweet made from ground peanuts, brown sugar and rice flour. It is a traditional food of Madagascar (where it is also known as koba ravina or kobandravina), especially in the highlands.

dishes.name: Lasary
dishes.description: Lasary is a type of Malagasy salad. It is believed that the dish originates from northern Madagascar. The dish is also named Antsary or Ansary in some places.
